posts.description: Finn the Knight Sol, Concept Sketch by my Fiancé, Micah White Finn stood outside the castle wall, its stone silhouette looming over her. posts.title: Zines Out! (Digitally)
posts.description: SO! Forgotten Keep is out (digitally)! It's smaller than I originally planned, for various reasons, but mainly because the scope started to exceed my reasonable means hahaha. It features work from me and other people in my local scene! All art by me unless otherwise attributed, physical prints soon! :) You can find it HERE!
